en.title: oi in doi (two)
en.summary: This item illustrates the Romanian diphthong oi as found in the word doi.

sections.title: The sound of oi
paragraphs: The letters oi sound like the sound /oj/. You hear them in the word (doi) /doj/, which means two. This pair makes only one sound in Romanian.

sections.title: How to say oi
paragraphs: Round your lips tightly and pull your tongue back. Start making a clear vowel sound. Then quickly glide your tongue up and forward toward your upper teeth. Spread your lips slightly at the end. Your voice box vibrates all the time. Place a hand on your throat to feel the steady vibration throughout the sound.

sections.title: Spelling rules for oi
paragraphs: The letters oi make the sound /oj/ in all positions. You hear it at the end of the word (foi) /foj/. It also appears with the exact same sound in the middle of words.

sections.title: Mistakes with oi
paragraphs: You may stretch this pair into two separate vowels. Do not say two syllables as in the English word fluid. The letters oi glide together quickly in one single push of air. They sound very close to the end of the English word boy.
